# Elorus

Elorus is an online invoicing and time-tracking software designed for freelancers and small businesses to manage their finances and projects efficiently.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/elorus/.

## Actions

- **Create Invoice**: Create a new invoice.
- **CREATE_PRODUCT**: Create a new product or service in elorus.
- **Email Invoice**: Email an existing invoice to specified contacts.
- **Get Bills**: Retrieve a list of bills.
- **Get Contacts**: Retrieve a list of contacts.
- **Get Credit Notes**: Retrieve a list of credit notes.
- **Get Email Templates**: Retrieve a list of email templates.
- **Get Estimates**: Retrieve a list of estimates.
- **Get Invoices**: Retrieve a list of invoices.
- **Get Products**: Retrieve a list of products/services with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.
- **Get Taxes**: Retrieve a list of taxes.
- **Get Templates**: Retrieve a list of document templates.
- **Update Contact**: Update an existing contact by id.
